courseDesc.body: (PQ: COS2015 or COS2112) This course is a comprehensive overview of the broad topic of data communications as the foundation for cybersecurity. Networking models, including ISO OSI and TCP/IP version 5, are used as a framework. Topics include data transmission, transmission media, network topologies, network cabling systems, IP and MAC addressing, TCP/IP protocol suite, local area networks (LANs), wide area networks (WANs), wireless networks, and network security. Students complete numerous practical laboratories using modern hardware and networking tools.
